python - <<'MHI_LAYOUT_AUDIT'
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/disk1/MHINet')
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
index=json.loads((root/'versions/v1/archive_index.json').read_text())
checks=[]
for entry in index['files']:
 actual=digest(root/entry['archive'])
 assert actual==entry['sha256'],entry['archive']
 if entry.get('source_commit'):
  raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',entry['source_commit']+':'+entry['source']],cwd=root)
  assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==entry['sha256']
checks.append({'id':'v1_archive_hashes_and_historical_sources','status':'pass','files':len(index['files'])})
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','3cab699:artifacts/mhi_v1_freeze.json'],cwd=root)
assert original==(root/'versions/v1/freeze_manifest.json').read_bytes()
checks.append({'id':'immutable_freeze_bytes','status':'pass','sha256':digest(root/'versions/v1/freeze_manifest.json')})
relocations=json.loads((root/'versions/relocations.json').read_text())
assert all(not (root/old).exists() and (root/new).is_file() for old,new in relocations['paths'].items())
checks.append({'id':'single_canonical_archive_paths','status':'pass','path_mapping':relocations['paths']})
legacy=git('diff','--name-status','mhi-v1','--','mhinet','configs','scripts','tests','artifacts/loma_downstream_source.json')
allowed=('mhinet/v2/','configs/mhi_v2/','scripts/mhi_v2/','tests/v2/')
for line in legacy.splitlines():
 status,path=line.split('\t',1)
 assert status=='A' and path.startswith(allowed),line
checks.append({'id':'legacy_base_unchanged','status':'pass','only_allowed_new_files':legacy.splitlines()})
md=[root/'README.md',*(root/'versions').rglob('*.md'),*(root/'mhinet/v2').rglob('*.md'),*(root/'configs/mhi_v2').rglob('*.md'),*(root/'tests/v2').rglob('*.md'),*(root/'weight/mhi_v2').rglob('*.md')]
links=0
for p in md:
 for destination in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if '://' not in destination and not destination.startswith('#'):
   assert (p.parent/destination.split('#')[0]).exists(),(str(p),destination)
   links+=1
checks.append({'id':'local_document_links','status':'pass','documents':len(md),'links':links})
checklist=(root/'versions/v2/ACCEPTANCE.md').read_text()
ids=re.findall(r'^### \[ [x ] \] (V2-P\d-\d{2})：',checklist,re.M)
if not ids:ids=re.findall(r'^### \[[x ]\] (V2-P\d-\d{2})：',checklist,re.M)
state=json.loads((root/'versions/v2/acceptance_status.json').read_text())
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==27
assert ids==[x['id'] for x in state['items']]
checks.append({'id':'acceptance_item_ids','status':'pass','items':27,'stages':{f'P{i}':sum(x.startswith(f'V2-P{i}-') for x in ids) for i in range(6)}})
origins={}
code='import json,mhinet; print(json.dumps({"module":mhinet.__file__}))'
for worktree in (root,Path('/home/disk1/MHINet-v1')):
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',code],cwd=worktree,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 module=json.loads(result.stdout)['module']
 assert Path(module).resolve()==worktree/'mhinet/__init__.py'
 origins[str(worktree)]=module
checks.append({'id':'separate_source_import_identity','status':'pass','actual':origins})
preparation=root/'versions/v2/evidence/preparation.json'
before=digest(preparation)
probe=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/mhi_v2/preflight.py'),'--output',str(preparation)],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert probe.returncode==2 and 'already exists' in probe.stderr and digest(preparation)==before
checks.append({'id':'existing_evidence_overwrite_refused','status':'pass','exit_code':probe.returncode,'report_sha256_unchanged':before})
print(json.dumps({'schema':'mhi.v2-layout-audit.v1','item_id':'V2-P0-01','status':'pass','checked_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(timespec='seconds'),'execution_base_commit':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),'checks':checks,'engineering':'pass','training':'not_started','accuracy':'not_started'},ensure_ascii=False))

MHI_LAYOUT_AUDIT
